abstract: Over 600 of the 850 cases of gestational trophoblastic disease that have been treated in our department during the last 20 years were reviewed to determine the role of surgery in the management of the disease. The surgical procedures employed included hysterectomy, both as a prophylactic and definitive procedure, thoracotomy, excision of vaginal nodules and neurosurgical removal of cerebral secondaries. It was found that removal of a large tumor mass improved the response to subsequent chemotherapy. Removal of vaginal nodules usually was not necessary unless there was hemorrhage. Chemotherapy with precise hormonal monitoring remains the most important means of treating choriocarcinoma.
abstract_ja: 当院では過去20年間に妊娠性絨毛性疾患850例を治療したが、そのうち600例以上を見直し、本疾患の管理における外科手術の役割を検討した。施行した手術は、予防的および根治的目的の子宮摘出術、開胸術、膣結節切除術、脳転移の脳神経外科的切除である。大きな腫瘍塊の切除は、その後の化学療法への反応を改善することが分かった。膣結節の切除は、出血がない限り通常は不要であった。絨毛癌の治療には、正確なホルモンモニタリングを伴う化学療法が最も重要な手段である。
